name: Singapore Post Limited (SingPost)

scam_info.sample: the links will only point to the following websites operated by SingPost: Singpost.com vPost.com SgLocate.com Ezyparcels.com Speedpost.com.sg MySam.sg Ezy2ship.net
scam_info.notes: 'Online Security & You' hub: explicit list of SingPost-operated domains (official); official email only @singpost.com; payments only via SingPost Mobile App, SAM machines or post office, never an online link; tracking only via app and singpost.com/track-items; SMS replaced by app push notifications since 28 Feb 2022 (SMS still used for OTPs, POPStation, queue tickets, CS follow-up). Also gives look-alike URL examples (fake, text only): www.singpost.com.xyz.com, www.singpost.net, www.singpost.org; and impersonating sender names 'SGPOST' / 'SINGPOST'. FAQ: report/verify via hotline 1605; SingPost does not initiate automated voice calls.

scam_info.sample: Scam Alert (01 Jan 2024): Please be aware of new scam emails and SMS impersonating SingPost requesting you to click on a link, provide personal information, or make payments for fake duties.
scam_info.notes: Service Announcements feed (409 dated items 2023-2026, data embedded as JSON in the page HTML). Mostly postal-service disruptions; only 1 scam item ('Scam Alert', 01 Jan 2024). Filter titles for scam|phish|fraud|impersonat. Re-fetched 2026-11-26 HTTP 200 to get newest date (2026-11-23).

hotlines: 1605 (SingPost customer service hotline; verify suspicious calls/SMS/email)
apps: SingPost Mobile (iOS App Store id647986630; Google Play com.singPost)

notes: official_domains: all seven are (a) explicitly listed on /online-security-you as 'websites operated by SingPost'; singpost.com and vpost.com are also (b) linked from the homepage. sms_sender_ids 'SingPost' comes from SPF advisory 2024-11-22 ('The SMS Sender ID of Singapore Post is SingPost'), not from SingPost's own page; SingPost's own page lists 'SGPOST'/'SINGPOST' as impersonation variants. Social: facebook.com/singpost, instagram mysingpost, linkedin from page footer; facebook.com/SingaporePost and twitter.com/SingaporePost from JSON-LD sameAs on /track-items. qualtrics siteintercept host seen (third-party survey script) not recorded. SPF also published 2026-03-27 advisory on WhatsApp messages impersonating SingPost (police.gov.sg; belongs to SPF registry).
